datasets.name: 45db3610
queryLines:
WITH rec AS (
  SELECT * FROM client_dev.ops.sap_reconciliation
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM client_dev.ops.sap_reconciliation)
),
latest AS (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) AS d FROM client_dev.gold.fact_sales)
SELECT concat('SAP billing data up to ', date_format(MAX(latest.d), 'd MMM yyyy'), '  |  ',
              CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rec.status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING), ' of ', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING),
              ' reconciliation checks (source to silver to gold) passed') AS status
FROM rec CROSS JOIN latest

datasets.name: d969dca5
queryLines:
SELECT *, ROUND(this_period_raw, 1) AS this_period, ROUND(last_year_raw, 1) AS same_days_last_year,
       ROUND(change_raw, 1) AS change_vs_ly
FROM (
SELECT CAST(revenue_mtd AS DOUBLE) AS revenue_mtd,
       CAST(ROUND((revenue_mtd / NULLIF(revenue_ly, 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS revenue_change_pct,
       CAST(ROUND(margin_pct_mtd, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS margin_pct_mtd,
       stack(6,
         1, 'Net revenue (LKR m)', CAST(revenue_mtd / 1e6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(revenue_ly / 1e6 AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((revenue_mtd / NULLIF(revenue_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         2, 'Gross margin %', CAST(margin_pct_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(margin_pct_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST(margin_pct_mtd - margin_pct_ly AS DOUBLE),
         3, 'Paid invoices', CAST(invoices_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(invoices_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((invoices_mtd / NULLIF(invoices_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         4, 'Active customers', CAST(customers_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(customers_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((customers_mtd / NULLIF(customers_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         5, 'Average invoice value (LKR 000)', CAST(aiv_mtd / 1e3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(aiv_ly / 1e3 AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((aiv_mtd / NULLIF(aiv_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         6, 'Returns rate %', CAST(returns_pct_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(returns_pct_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST(returns_pct_mtd - returns_pct_ly AS DOUBLE)
       ) AS (row_order, kpi, this_period_raw, last_year_raw, change_raw)
FROM (
  SELECT
    MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS revenue_mtd,
    MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS revenue_ly,
    MAX(gross_margin_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS margin_pct_mtd,
    MAX(gross_margin_pct) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS margin_pct_ly,
    MAX(invoice_count) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS invoices_mtd,
    MAX(invoice_count) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS invoices_ly,
    MAX(active_customers) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS customers_mtd,
    MAX(active_customers) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS customers_ly,
    MAX(average_invoice_value) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS aiv_mtd,
    MAX(average_invoice_value) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS aiv_ly,
    MAX(returns_rate_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS returns_pct_mtd,
    MAX(returns_rate_pct) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS returns_pct_ly
  FROM (
    SELECT `is_month_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`, MEASURE(`gross_margin_pct`) AS `gross_margin_pct`, MEASURE(`invoice_count`) AS `invoice_count`, MEASURE(`active_customers`) AS `active_customers`, MEASURE(`average_invoice_value`) AS `average_invoice_value`, MEASURE(`returns_rate_pct`) AS `returns_rate_pct`
    FROM client_dev.gold.sales_metrics
    WHERE (is_month_to_date OR is_same_days_last_year) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group) AND (:channel = 'All' OR channel = :channel)
    GROUP BY ALL
  ) AS q
) AS previous
) AS kpis
ORDER BY row_order

SELECT
  month,
  document_type,
  ROUND(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 2) AS lkr_m
FROM (
  SELECT `month`, `document_type`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`
  FROM client_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_current_fiscal_year OR is_previous_fiscal_year) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group) AND (:channel = 'All' OR channel = :channel)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q

datasets.name: 2729cb07
queryLines:
SELECT
  product_group,
  ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_last_complete_month) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 1) AS lkr_m,
  ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_last_complete_month) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_last_complete_month), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct
FROM (
  SELECT `product_group`, `is_last_complete_month`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`
  FROM client_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_last_complete_month OR is_last_complete_month_last_year) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group) AND (:channel = 'All' OR channel = :channel)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q
GROUP BY product_group

datasets.name: 495998ab
queryLines:
SELECT
  product,
  product_group,
  ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 2) AS lkr_m,
  ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_fiscal_year_to_date), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct,
  CAST(MAX(units) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) AS units,
  ROUND(MAX(gross_margin_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM (
  SELECT `product`, `product_group`, `is_fiscal_year_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`, MEASURE(`units`) AS `units`, MEASURE(`gross_margin_pct`) AS `gross_margin_pct`
  FROM client_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_fiscal_year_to_date OR is_same_period_last_fiscal_year) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group) AND (:channel = 'All' OR channel = :channel)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q
GROUP BY product, product_group
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 7a1fb00e
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_name,
  customer_group,
  province,
  ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 2) AS lkr_m,
  ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_fiscal_year_to_date), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct,
  CAST(MAX(invoice_count) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) AS invoices
FROM (
  SELECT `customer_name`, `customer_group`, `province`, `is_fiscal_year_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`, MEASURE(`invoice_count`) AS `invoice_count`
  FROM client_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_fiscal_year_to_date OR is_same_period_last_fiscal_year) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group) AND (:channel = 'All' OR channel = :channel)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q
GROUP BY customer_name, customer_group, province
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: 0020b6bf
queryLines:
SELECT CASE fate
         WHEN 'kept' THEN 'In silver and gold'
         WHEN 'older_version' THEN 'Older copy of a line (the newest is kept)'
         WHEN 'deleted_in_source' THEN 'Deleted in SAP'
         WHEN 'out_of_scope_company' THEN 'Another company code'
         WHEN 'not_revenue' THEN 'Pro-forma or down payment (not revenue)'
         WHEN 'quarantined' THEN 'Quarantined: bad date, key or number'
         WHEN 'outside_window' THEN 'Outside the agreed date window'
         ELSE fate END AS what_happened,
       CAST(SUM(line_count) AS DOUBLE) AS row_count
FROM client_dev.ops.sap_row_fates
GROUP BY fate
ORDER BY CASE fate WHEN 'kept' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, row_count DESC

datasets.name: fcf982ec
queryLines:
SELECT CASE check_name WHEN 'source_to_silver' THEN 'Source to silver (per company, month, category)'
                       WHEN 'silver_to_gold' THEN 'Silver to gold (per invoice date and type)'
                       ELSE check_name END AS link,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS group_count,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS passed,
       CAST(SUM(actual_lines) AS DOUBLE) AS line_count
FROM client_dev.ops.sap_reconciliation
WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM client_dev.ops.sap_reconciliation)
GROUP BY check_name
ORDER BY check_name DESC

datasets.name: f5f84e2c
queryLines:
SELECT layer, check_name, status, COUNT(*) AS results,
       date_format(from_utc_timestamp(MAX(checked_ts), 'Asia/Colombo'), 'd MMM yyyy HH:mm') AS last_run
FROM client_dev.ops.dq_results
WHERE run_id IN (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM client_dev.ops.dq_results GROUP BY layer, check_name)
GROUP BY layer, check_name, status
ORDER BY CASE layer WHEN 'bronze' THEN 1 WHEN 'silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, check_name, status
